exposure: Heart rate monitoring method (pulse oximeter vs. electrocardiogram)
outcome: Time from birth to arrival at resuscitation bay
Time from birth to initial heart rate assessment
Time from birth to initiation of positive pressure ventilation
Time from sensor application to provision of a reliable heart rate signal
cohort: 104 newborns ≥34 weeks of gestation receiving positive pressure ventilation at birth
finding: Initial heart rate assessment and initiation of positive pressure ventilation were achieved within 60 seconds after birth in only one-third of newborn resuscitations.
mod_finding: Time to initial heart rate assessment and initiating positive pressure ventilation was significantly longer following vaginal deliveries than caesarean sections.
